import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
code=json.loads((ns['root']/'source/coast_19_muted_earth.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['code']
code=code.replace('[142,122,102]','[128,103,82]').replace('[140,120,101]','[132,106,85]').replace('[121,106,89]','[106,84,65]').replace('[151,133,111]','[148,127,98]').replace('[112,123,112]','[121,112,94]')
code=code.replace("if o.name.startswith('Canopy lap'):","if o.name.startswith(('Canopy lap','Canopy broad course')):")
exec(code)
# Deep material values are evaluated under side daylight, not painted highlights.
ns['glass'].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(.045,.052,.047,1)
ns['glass'].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.58
ns['stone'].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(.14,.125,.10,1)
import numpy as np, math
yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:256,0:256];u=xx/256;v=yy/256
tone=6*np.sin(math.tau*(v*3-u*2))+1.3*np.sin(math.tau*(v*21-u*14))
ra=np.ones((256,256,4),dtype=np.float32);ra[:,:,:3]=(np.array([152,136,106])+tone[:,:,None]*np.array([1,.9,.65]))/255
ns['png'](ns['out']/'HarborCraft_Hemp_albedo.png',ra)
for im in bpy.data.images:
    if Path(im.filepath).name=='HarborCraft_Hemp_albedo.png':
        if im.packed_file:im.unpack(method='REMOVE')
        im.reload();im.pack()
ns['export_asset']()
print('DEEP_TIMBER_CONTACT_AND_DAYLIGHT_ASSET_READY')
